evals.prompt: we're planning to deploy this api to prod next week. is it ready? give me the list of what needs fixing first
evals.expected_output: Severity-ranked report with a Not ready verdict, Blockers for missing auth, TRACE bind logging of PII, default DB credentials; build/test results; concrete fixes with file:line.
assertions: Gives an explicit overall verdict of not ready / not production-ready
Flags the missing authentication/authorization layer (no Spring Security) as a top-priority / blocker issue
Flags hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind=TRACE (or SQL parameter logging) as leaking personal/sensitive data into logs
Flags the default DB credential fallback (${DB_PASSWORD:admin} / admin) in application.properties
Flags that clients can set payment status (e.g. to COMPLETED) via a public endpoint as a business/security risk
Reports the outcome of actually running the test suite (./mvnw test) with pass/fail counts or a stated reason it could not run
Gives at least 5 findings with file:line locations
Contains no false positive claiming foreign-key columns are unindexed and does not recommend JOIN FETCH on PESSIMISTIC_WRITE lock queries

evals.prompt: before I tag v1.0 can you do a pre-release review focused on security and config only - don't need the perf stuff
evals.expected_output: Report limited to security/config/secrets/exposure findings, with verdict and file:line locations; no N+1 or index findings.
assertions: Flags the missing authentication/authorization layer (no Spring Security)
Flags hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind=TRACE (or SQL parameter logging) as leaking personal/sensitive data into logs
Flags the default DB credential fallback (${DB_PASSWORD:admin} / admin) in application.properties
Flags Swagger UI / api-docs being exposed in prod (incl. try-it-out enabled)
Respects the scope: contains no N+1, query-performance or index findings
